clearance_assumptions.meaning: Inherited local layout marker from existing project hole pattern. This is NOT an HC-11 head/base dimensional guarantee or enclosure adhesive-pad envelope.

flat_floor_screen.status: KNOWN NOMINAL INTERFERENCE for component-side-toward-flat-floor installation
flat_floor_screen.coordinate_convention: Board B component/front plane is z=0; its substrate extends to−1.6. HC-11 base/enclosure floor is on the component side, nominallyz=+11.0. Front-mounted flipped P component-face plane is+11.1 and P substrate extends toward+12.7.
conditions: This is a flat enclosure floor covering the populated board area, with the Board B component face toward that floor. Different mounting orientation or real enclosure cutouts require a new geometric screen.
PD solder tails/other outward geometry may extend farther than12.7mm;1.7mm is already a sufficient lower bound on the present incompatibility.
Moving the PD board laterally cannot solve a global flat-floor height conflict by itself.
PCB seating tolerance, adhesive compression, component seating and routing/wire access are not added margins.

A taller support or deliberate floor clearance is required for this orientation.16mm is a candidate only, not a selected/verified exact support; it gives1.8mm nominal residual over terminal drawing maximum before other assembly limits.
